missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Положение' is the neuter nominative subject. 'Сложное' is the agreeing neuter adjective, intensified by 'очень'. A clean model for describing a situation.

Strategic focus: Accusative object. Neuter 'положение' has an accusative identical to the nominative, here the direct object of 'исправить'. 'Это' agrees in the neuter accusative. A common action statement.
Strategic focus: Genitive with preposition. 'От положения' uses the genitive 'положения' after 'от', and 'дел' is the genitive plural of 'дело'. A natural idiom for the state of affairs.
Strategic focus: Dative object. 'Положению' is the dative governed by 'рад' (glad of). 'Своему новому' agrees in the neuter dative. A strong evaluation model.

Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'В трудном положении' uses the prepositional 'положении' after 'в' to express the situation. 'Трудном' agrees in the neuter prepositional. A very common idiom.
Strategic focus: Instrumental object. 'Положением' is the instrumental governed by 'гордится' (proud of). 'Своим' agrees in the neuter instrumental. A natural pride model.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'В этом положении' uses the prepositional 'положении' to locate a possibility. 'Выход' is the nominative subject of 'есть'. A hopeful situational pattern.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural. 'Положения' is the accusative plural, the direct object of 'описывает', here meaning provisions. 'Основные' agrees in the plural. Useful legal vocabulary.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О своём положении' uses the prepositional 'положении' after 'о' to express the topic of thought. 'Своём' agrees in the neuter prepositional. A reflective frame.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Положение' is the neuter accusative, the direct object of 'улучшила'. 'Своё материальное' agrees in the neuter accusative. A practical socioeconomic pattern.
